True if the workload is revoked

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

registerWorkload((string,string,uint64,u.details: Workload ID is computed as:      keccak256(abi.encode(WORKLOAD_DOMAIN, ownerFingerprint, spec.name, spec.version))      The owner fingerprint qualifies the name, so each publisher has its own      name space and a name cannot be squatted across publishers.

params.ownerIdentity: The public key identity of the workload owner
params.ownerSignature: Signature over the workload registration data by ownerIdentity
params.spec: Complete workload specification (name, version, policy, pcrs).      `sessionTtl` must not exceed `MAX_SESSION_TTL` (100 years); 0 selects the      SessionRegistry default.

returns.workloadId: The unique identifier for the registered workload (domain-separated hash)

registerWorkloadV2((string,string,uint64.details: The V2 publication signature also binds workloadSignature.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

MAX_SESSION_TTL().notice: Maximum accepted workload session TTL. A TTL of 0 selects the SessionRegistry         default; any nonzero TTL must not exceed this bound. The bound sits roughly         nine orders of magnitude below the uint64 overflow point of the expiry         computation (~5.8e11 years), so overflow safety is not the constraint; the         point is that a TTL beyond a century is indistinguishable from a permanent         session and almost certainly a mistake.
